nodes.label: Cash-account allocation pilot
nodes.rationale: An additive $1,000 study retains the earlier $100 observed-drawdown guard and compares A_cash_legacy, B_single_legacy and C_single_max. Settlement/feasibility repairs are separated from daily-selection/allocation changes, with fixed signal/exits, independent stress fixtures and exact artifact reconciliation.

nodes.label: Conservative T+1 settled-cash ledger
nodes.rationale: Economic cash equals settled plus signed unsettled proceeds; entries use settled cash less reservations and negative receivables. Settlement transfers balances without changing equity. A validated business-day calendar posts at assumed 09:30 Eastern; missing dates fail closed and horizon receivables remain unsettled.

nodes.label: First-feasible single-entry daily selection
nodes.rationale: Reject empty admissible ask intervals before reservations. Select the earliest feasible setup, break simultaneous ties alphabetically and allow one pending order. The first positive partial/full fill consumes the daily allowance; no top-up is allowed, and carried positions block new entries.
